config.asymmetry_caveat: TSDiff-W draws genuine diffusion samples; the 5 baselines draw Gaussian samples parametrically from their stored 95% PI, matching PRODUCTION's own weekly protocol (Monte-Carlo/bootstrap too costly at D+7+) -- not a shortcut invented for this backtest. If TSDiff-W wins, check the gain isn't just the baselines' Gaussian handicap; if it loses despite that potential handicap, the result is more robust.
